app.name: FoundBack
app.tagline: Lost something? Found something? Get it back to its owner, safely.
app.disclaimer: FoundBack connects people. Meet only in safe public places.

header.countryExplainBody: Items, maps, matches, safe places and guidance on FoundBack are limited to your country, so everything you see is nearby and relevant. You can only claim items in {{country}}.
header.countryExplainChange: Moved to another country? You can change it in Settings.

language.title: Choose your language
language.partial: Partly translated, missing text shows in English

signIn.title: Sign in to FoundBack
signIn.subtitle: Use your phone number. We'll text you a 6-digit code.
signIn.phoneHint: Enter the number without the country code, or with it.
signIn.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}} s
signIn.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not set up yet.
signIn.terms: By continuing you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

points.privateBody: Finders and owners never see each other's phone number until both agree.
points.proofBody: Hidden questions and proof stop anyone else from claiming your things.
points.localBody: You see items, maps and guidance for the country you live in.

country.title: Which country do you live in?
country.body: You'll see and claim items only in this country. You can change it later if you move.

city.title: Which city are you in?
city.body: We use it to show items near you. Only cities in {{country}} are listed.
city.search: Search for your city or town
city.homeBody: Tap the map to set the area you want “near me” to use. Nobody else can see it.
city.locationDenied: We couldn't get your location. Tap the map instead.

phone.title: Verify your phone number
phone.body: Your number is never shown to other people. It must be a {{country}} number.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: English is selected. You can switch any time with the globe icon.
language.nameHint: Shown to people you exchange items with. No phone numbers or emails.

home.returnedCount_one: {{count}} item returned to its owner in {{country}}
home.returnedCount_other: {{count}} items returned to their owners in {{country}}
home.waitingCount_one: {{count}} found item is waiting for its owner
home.waitingCount_other: {{count}} found items are waiting for their owners
home.comingTitle: Posting and searching open in the next update
home.comingBody: Your profile is ready. As soon as posting opens, you'll be able to report what you found or lost in {{country}}.

next.new: Verify your phone number to start posting and claiming.
next.phone_verified: Return items to become a Trusted returner.
next.identity_verified: Return items to become a Trusted returner.
next.trusted_returner: Thank you for helping people get their things back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.changeCountryBody: Only change this if you have moved. You'll see items in the new country only, you'll need to set your city and verify a phone number from that country again, and you can't change it again for 30 days.
settings.changeCountryCooldown: You can change your country again on {{date}}.
settings.privacyBody: We keep only what's needed to return items. Phone numbers, ID numbers and hidden answers are encrypted.
settings.deleteBody: Your profile, phone number and open posts are removed. This can't be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not valid. Please check and try again.
errors.PHONE_INVALID: That phone number doesn't look right.
errors.PHONE_COUNTRY_MISMATCH: Please use a phone number from your country.
errors.PHONE_IN_USE: This number is already used by another account.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.COUNTRY_MISMATCH: That place is not in your country.
errors.COUNTRY_DISABLED: FoundBack isn't available in this country yet.
errors.COUNTRY_COOLDOWN: You can only change your country once every 30 days.
errors.CITY_INVALID: Please pick a city from the list.
errors.LOCATION_OUTSIDE_COUNTRY: That point is outside your country. Pick a spot inside it.
errors.GEOCODER_UNAVAILABLE: Place search is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.DISPLAY_NAME_INVALID: Your name can't contain phone numbers, emails or links.
errors.ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE: A few profile steps are still missing.
errors.GOOGLE_DISABLED: Google sign-in is not set up yet.
